name: proof-tree-companion
description: Editor-side commands for the proof-tree infoview widget: opens a tactic in the lens (a slim editor group split below the infoview) and reveals tree nodes in it, relayed through a request file the widget's Lean RPC writes (the infoview's EditorApi has no executeCommand). Will also grow global settings / persistent state for the widget.

commands.title: Proof Tree: Open Tactic in Lens
